description: This file defines SwiftUI views for rendering and managing a dynamic configuration form based on a JSON schema, particularly for channel configurations within an application.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders UI components for different schema types such as object, array, boolean, number, and string, based on the provided schema node.

methods.name: renderStringField
methods.description: Renders a TextField or SecureField for string input, including handling of enum options.

methods.name: renderNumberField
methods.description: Renders a TextField for numeric input, handling both integer and floating-point types.

methods.name: renderArray
methods.description: Renders a list of array items with controls to add or remove items.

methods.name: renderAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Renders UI for managing extra key-value pairs not predefined in the schema.

methods.name: stringBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to a string configuration value with trimming and default handling.

methods.name: boolBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: numberBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to a numeric value, converting between String and Double/Int as needed.

methods.name: enumBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for enum options, represented as an integer index.

methods.name: mapKeyBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for updating keys within a dictionary of extra properties.
